turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have a client call at 4:40, Hale. Owen found out about his zero on his phone, in the middle of a class, and nobody called me first. Who decided that, and on what basis?
I appreciate you coming in with an open mind.
Don't manage me. Who decided, and on what basis?
A lot of parents in your position would have gone straight to the principal. You didn't. That says a lot about you.
I still might, today. Save the compliments and show me something with a date on it.
So I'd like to keep this between us and keep it friendly. Deal?
No deal. Everything said in this room goes in an email to you and the principal tonight. What do you actually have on Owen's essay?
